tools.name: architect.entries.list
tools.title: List Architect Entries
tools.description: List structured engineering memory entries by status, tag, or text query.

tools.name: cli.powershell.execute
tools.title: Execute PowerShell Script
tools.description: Runs a PowerShell script and returns ordered execution tracks, stdout, stderr, exit code, duration, and status.

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to the current JVM working directory.

timeoutMs.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 and is capped by the tool.

executable.description: Optional PowerShell executable. Defaults to pwsh. Use powershell.exe for Windows PowerShell.

environment.description: Optional environment variables to add or override for the child process.

includeScriptInStructuredContent.description: Whether to echo the script body in structuredContent. Defaults to false.

name.description: The name of the person to greet

tools.name: instagram.fetch
tools.title: Instagram Fetch
tools.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

inputSchema.description: Fetches data from Instagram based on a given URL.

url.description: The URL of the Instagram post to fetch data from.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt.connect_registered
tools.title: Connect Registered Session
tools.description: Connect a previously paired WhatsApp Web session by alias.

deviceName.description: Device name shown in WhatsApp linked devices.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for the registered session to connect.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt.disconnect
tools.title: Disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect the active WhatsApp session, or log out when requested.

logout.description: When true, log out and invalidate the saved WhatsApp session. Otherwise only disconnect.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for disconnect or logout.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt.send_text
tools.title: Send Text
tools.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp phone number or JID. Does not read chats or messages.

recipient.description: WhatsApp recipient as a phone number with country code or full JID.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for Cobalt to send the message.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt.start_pairing
tools.title: Start Pairing
tools.description: Start a WhatsApp Web pairing flow and return either a pairing code or raw QR payload.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number with country code and digits only. Required for pairing_code.

deviceName.description: Device name shown in WhatsApp linked devices.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds to wait for a QR payload or pairing code.

tools.name: whatsapp.cobalt.status
tools.title: Status
tools.description: Return the local WhatsApp Cobalt session status without exposing chats or messages.

inputSchema.description: Return the local WhatsApp Cobalt session status without exposing chats or messages.
